name: KeyForge3D
summary: Desktop app that extracts a key's shape from a photo, reads its bitting pattern and exports a 3D-printable STL file.
description: A Python Tkinter application for replicating physical keys: upload a photo of a key shot on a plain background and it extracts the 2D profile with OpenCV, detects and displays the bitting pattern (e.g. 05624), builds a 3D model with Trimesh and saves it as keymodel.stl for printing. Scaling defaults to 1 pixel = 0.1 mm, with reference-object scaling, key-type identification and a mobile version on the roadmap.
contains: extracts a key's 2D profile from a photo with OpenCV
detects and displays the bitting pattern (e.g. 05624)
generates a 3D model and exports keymodel.stl
Tkinter GUI: upload an image, process and save in one click
scale default 1 pixel = 0.1 mm; reference-object scaling planned
Python 3.8+; opencv-python, numpy, trimesh, shapely, pillow
roadmap: key-type identification, ML bitting, mobile app
